comments.text:
tk-z9a done — widget: 8-line attention render.

Commit 62c4108 on matchday/tk-z9a, pushed.

Implementation:
- extensions/widget.ts: WidgetModel + decodeFrame (docs/02 §Event frames; unknown/malformed dropped) + applyFrame fold + renderWidget + createWidgetController (250ms trailing debounce, states idle/busy/attach/summary-flash, setWidget only when lines changed, offline → '(hub offline)' + bounded reconnect backoff 1s→30s).
- extensions/hub_sock.ts: hub.sock subscription feed (hello subscribe:true → ch:event frames), mirrors cli/src/hub_events.ts pattern (extensions can't import cli per docs/01 import matrix; decode kept in widget.ts so no duplication was extracted — real duplication is one frame-walk loop).
- extensions/hub.ts wiring: widget controller started on /hub-start, stopped on /hub-stop + session_shutdown (clears WIDGET_KEY). Events reach it two ways: in-process EventBus tap (hub_local.subscribeWidget — hub-local events incl. CLI ops) + hub.sock subscription (peer mirror). NO_COLOR → plain.
- Hue bars: lib barrel hueColorCodes — shared hash, no re-hash (verified idempotent in test vs lib).
- lib/package.json: exposed ./ports/* subpath so the extension imports the Scheduler type for injected timers.

Acceptance evidence:
- bun test workspace: 598 pass / 0 fail (22 new widget tests: 8-line budget incl. 20-session/9-item stress, line-1 counts ⚠ human kinds + ⏳ working|waiting + 💤 idle + top item + answer hint, hue-bar equality with lib barrel + idempotence, state transitions + attach one-refresh, 250ms debounce one-paint-per-burst, offline degrade + backoff, NO_COLOR zero escapes, fold invariants).
- tsc --noEmit: clean. lib/cli bun run check builds pass.
- Note: hub.test.ts has a pre-existing flake (sleep-race in P2-4/report-frames tests, reproducible at base 5cd9fdf ~1/12 runs) — not from this change, left untouched (sibling scope).
- Against ISC: budget enforced by lines.slice(0,8) + compact slot omission (docs example 6-line render honored); overflow beats summary on line 7 per table; footer sock path + summaries count; idle dims (30s no events + no open attention).

Left OPEN for validator.
